description: Source code for pcap_file_writer class handling PCAP file writing, including opening, closing, flushing, and writing packet data and headers, with helper functions for dissecting protocol data units.

classes.name: pcap_file_writer
classes.description: Class responsible for writing PCAP files, managing file streams, headers, and data packets.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a PCAP file for writing, initializes header.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the file stream if open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the PCAP file stream after flushing.

methods.name: write_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes a packet header with timestamp and length info.

methods.name: write_exported_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes a header for exported protocol data units, including dissector info.

methods.name: write_pdu
methods.description: Writes a PDU from a span of bytes.

methods.name: write_pdu
methods.description: Writes a PDU from a byte_buffer object.
